title: Family Secrets
overview: جیلین، وکیلی جسور، و ایلگاز، دادستانی پایبند به قانون، در جریان تحقیق دربارهٔ یک قتل با هم روبه‌رو می‌شوند. اختلاف نگاهشان به عدالت مانع همکاری سادهٔ آن‌هاست؛ به‌ویژه هنگامی که پرونده به زندگی خانواده‌های خودشان گره می‌خورد و مرز میان تعهد حرفه‌ای و وفاداری شخصی را به چالش می‌کشد.
notes: Reuses existing local series tt12979628, titled Family Secrets (2021). IMDb identifies its original title as Yargi and alternate title as The Judgment; the Ay Yapım producer page confirms the Family Secrets/Yargı identity and 2021 start year.

Input evidence: 300 unique media URL lines under /serial/turkish/Yargi/ in the inspected input, plus six directory/query lines. Examples: Yargi.S02E38.1080p56.mkv, Yargi.S02E38.720p56.mkv and Yargi.S01E65.1080p.mkv. This is a source-file count, not a count of episodes; the parent's filtered eligible-file total may differ.

Aliases are title-level filename prefixes only. Treat S01E65, S02E38, trailing quality digits such as 1080p56, and any episodes1/source ordering labels as unverified source semantics. Do not infer original Turkish broadcast season, absolute episode number, episode title, episode air date, or a re-edit mapping from this profile. Parent owns filename parsing and source-label preservation.

The generic English aliases Family Secrets and Judgment require the series type and 2021 identity as disambiguation; they must not be matched globally by substring to unrelated titles. In particular, Kanal D International's Family Secrets page is Babam ve Ailesi, a different production, and is deliberately not used as evidence for Yargı.

Ali Bilgin is credited by the producer; Prime Video and IMDb full credits additionally credit Beste Sultan Kasapoğulları. Prime Video's linked season page displays 2022, which is not substituted for the series' verified 2021 start year.

title: The Phoenix
overview: زمرد پس از رسیدن خبر مرگ سرحات، مردی که دوستش دارد، زیر فشار شرایط به ازدواج با عموی او تن می‌دهد. این تصمیم او را درگیر روابط دشوار خانوادهٔ دمیرکان و کشمکش میان عشق، وفاداری و اجبار می‌کند. داستان این درام ترکی در کاپادوکیه می‌گذرد.
notes: Original title: Zümrüdüanka. IMDb identifies the series as tt11561800, first released in 2020; it is not the German film Phoenix or the Indian films with that title.

Input evidence: /s1/ contains 123 MP4 URL lines, including قسمت_هشتاد_و_یکم_فصل_دوم_سریال_درام_ترکی_شعله_عشقدوبله_فارسی.mp4 and filenames ending in The_Phoenix. Aliases identify the title, not the episode.
The Persian title fragment occurs after a variable episode/season prefix in these filenames. Do not match a generic قسمت prefix. Match the decoded title fragment within the basename instead.

Persian dubbed/re-edited episode and season labels are unverified source labels, not a mapping to original Turkish broadcasts. No original episode numbers, episode titles, episode count, or episode air dates are assigned by this profile.
languages records the original language; the observed /s1/ files are labeled Persian dubbed. Do not interpret the profile language as a verified per-file audio probe.

Director credits use IMDb full credits, with initial director Cemal Şan corroborated by the broadcaster. The English producer page gives a different single director credit (Yaşar Şahin); no attempt is made to infer episode-level directing assignments.

title: Dabangg 2
